newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia unclear when Japan palladium talks to begin.
newsitem.headline: Russia unclear when Japan palladium talks to begin.

text.p: A Russian precious metals official said on Friday it was unclear when talks on 1997 palladium supply contracts with Japan would begin or when deliveries would start.
"It is still not clear yet when the talks will begin or when deliveries will start," Vladimir Rybkin, head of the Finance Ministry's precious metals and stones department, told Reuters.
"I think the problems will be overcome eventually, but I cannot say when at this stage," he said.
"The most important reason for the delays is the question of export licenses, and we still don't know when this problem will be resolved," he said, but provided no further details.
Talks between Russia, the world's biggest palladium producer, and Japan, the biggest consumer, have been delayed since mid-December.
